rows.note: For the eager-eating sense, this is the all-purpose colloquial choice for eating heartily and enthusiastically.

example.english: Let’s go to the cha chaan teng and munch away!
example.traditional: 我哋去茶記，大啖咁食先！
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 caa4 gei3 daai6 daam6 gam3 sik6 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on chewing something crunchy with an audible crunch.

example.english: You have to munch potato chips with a loud crunch for it to be satisfying.
example.traditional: 食薯片就要咬到咔咔聲先過癮。
example.jyutping: sik6 syu4 pin2 zau6 jiu3 ngaau5 dou3 kaa1 kaa1 sing1 sin1 gwo3 jan5
